visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a top-down view of an open white suitcase lying on a light wood floor. A woman's hand in a grey sweater points to various grey and white packing cubes inside. The room is brightly lit with natural-looking indoor light. (2) In close-up shots, the hand unzips the packing cubes to reveal folded clothes and travel accessories. The camera follows the hand's movements closely. (3) The creator displays specific travel items individually, including a pair of white slippers in a plastic bag, a cream-colored skincare bottle, and a white portable electric kettle. (4) The camera pans to the suitcase's top lid, which features multiple zippered mesh and fabric compartments containing tea bags and medical pouches. (5) A hidden side pocket is opened to show an AirTag and a black waist bag. (6) The final phase shows the creator standing, revealing her blue jeans as she demonstrates the suitcase's expansion zipper and provides a full overview of the organized luggage.
